## TRA Timeline

#### Contemplated SPAC business combination

- 2021-07-21: 8-K announces Business Combination Agreement with Olive Ventures Holdings, OP Group Holdings LLC, Normandy Holdco LLC, and CF OMS LLC; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit 10.1, contemplated to be executed simultaneously with Closing
- 2022-04-01: MDH and OP Group execute Termination of Business Combination Agreement
- 2022-04-04: Joint press release announces the termination; the TRA was never signed

## Explanation

MDH Acquisition Corp. was a SPAC that filed a form-of Tax Receivable Agreement as Exhibit 10.1 to its July 21, 2021 Business Combination Agreement 8-K, contemplating an Up-C structure under which the post-combination PubCo (Olive Ventures Holdings, Inc.) would have paid CF OMS LLC and the Blocker Owner 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 step-ups from the CF OMS Sale and from future exchanges of OP Group Common Units and Earnout Units, plus imputed interest and Blocker Pre-IPO Tax Assets. The form-of carries a blank preamble date and unsigned signature blocks and was contemplated to be entered into "Simultaneously with the Closing"; because MDH and OP Group mutually terminated the Business Combination Agreement on April 1, 2022 before any Closing occurred, the TRA was never executed. MDH continued as a shell SPAC through its Q3 2022 10-Q without further TRA references. The contract is recorded here as Terminated with creation-date and termination-date set to the BCA filing and termination dates respectively to flag the never-executed status while preserving the form-of record. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
